Alexander Bernhardsson.note: Bernhardsson's edge is making purposeful movement away from the ball. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track.
Alexander Bernhardsson.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是用有目的的无球移动创造接应点。他会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。他也会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。

Alexander Isak.note: Isak's edge is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track.
Alexander Isak.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在防线重组前制造干净射门。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。他也会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。

Anthony Elanga.note: Elanga stands out for creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target.
Anthony Elanga.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在防线重组前制造干净射门。他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。他也会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。

Benjamin Nygren.note: Nygren's signature is making purposeful movement away from the ball. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track.
Benjamin Nygren.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在用有目的的无球移动创造接应点上。他会传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。他也会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。

Besfort Zeneli.note: Zeneli's edge is creating a better angle for the next pass. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path.
Besfort Zeneli.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是为下一脚传球制造更好的角度。他会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。他也会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。

Carl Starfelt.note: Starfelt's signature is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He recognizes when to slow the play and when to take the risk.
Carl Starfelt.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢上。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会判断何时放慢节奏，何时承担风险。

Daniel Svensson.note: Svensson's signature is the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Daniel Svensson.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构上。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Elliot Stroud.note: Stroud's signature is making the safer decision before a duel becomes an emergency. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area.
Elliot Stroud.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在对抗变成险情前做出更安全的选择上。他会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。他也会传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。

Eric Smith.summary: Eric Smith is a Sweden centre-back at St. Pauli who gives the national team defensive midfield cover, back-line calm, and long passing.
Eric Smith.note: Smith is defined by moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. He varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Eric Smith.noteZh: 他靠用传球的力度和角度移动防线与同位置球员拉开差异。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Gabriel Gudmundsson.note: Gudmundsson's signature is recovering position without panicking after the first line is broken. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. He gets close enough to block the delivery without diving in.
Gabriel Gudmundsson.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在第一道防线被突破后仍能冷静回位上。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。他也会靠近到能封堵传中，但不贸然出脚。

Gustaf Lagerbielke.summary: Gustaf Lagerbielke is a Sweden centre-back at Braga who gives the national team aerial defending, duel strength, and back-line depth.
Gustaf Lagerbielke.note: Lagerbielke stands out for reading the flight of the ball before the duel begins. He changes position while keeping his priorities simple. He varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Gustaf Lagerbielke.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在争顶前先判断球的飞行轨迹。他会改变起始位置，但始终坚持清晰简单的处理原则。他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Gustaf Nilsson.summary: Gustaf Nilsson is a Sweden centre-forward at Club Brugge who gives the national team hold-up play, aerial presence, and penalty-box depth.
Gustaf Nilsson.note: Watch Nilsson for making the next teammate's action easier. He pins a defender and creates room for the next runner. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Gustaf Nilsson.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是让队友下一步处理更轻松。留意他如何牵制一名后卫，为后插上的队友腾出空间。他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Herman Johansson.note: Johansson's edge is pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him.
Herman Johansson.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。

Hjalmar Ekdal.note: Watch Ekdal for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose.
Hjalmar Ekdal.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。留意他如何主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。

Isak Hien.note: Hien is defined by protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He turns early and closes the runner before the box. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Isak Hien.noteZh: 他靠先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢与同位置球员拉开差异。他会提前转身，在对手进入禁区前缩短距离。他也会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。

Jacob Widell Zetterstrom.note: Zetterström's edge is staying ready through long quiet spells. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. He keeps the line connected with constant small instructions.
Jacob Widell Zetterstrom.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在长时间无事可做后依然保持专注。他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。他也会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。

Jesper Karlstrom.note: Karlström's signature is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Jesper Karlstrom.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢上。他会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Ken Sema.note: Sema's signature is calm decisions shaped by experience in high-pressure moments. He holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area.
Ken Sema.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在高压时刻由经验带来的冷静判断上。他会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。

Kristoffer Nordfeldt.note: Nordfeldt's signature is staying ready through long quiet spells. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders.
Kristoffer Nordfeldt.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在长时间无事可做后依然保持专注上。他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。他也会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Lucas Bergvall.note: Watch Bergvall for seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Lucas Bergvall.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。留意他如何第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Mattias Svanberg.note: Svanberg is defined by creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Mattias Svanberg.noteZh: 他靠在防线重组前制造干净射门与同位置球员拉开差异。他会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Taha Ali.note: Ali is defined by changing direction without losing control of the ball. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target.
Taha Ali.noteZh: 他靠变向时仍把球控制在脚下与同位置球员拉开差异。他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。他也会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。

Victor Lindelof.note: Lindelöf stands out for organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Victor Lindelof.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在危险出现前组织好队友。他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。他也会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。

Viktor Gyokeres.note: Gyökeres's signature is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. He absorbs contact and keeps the ball close enough to continue forward.
Viktor Gyokeres.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在防线重组前制造干净射门上。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。他也会承受身体接触后仍把球留在可继续推进的位置。

Viktor Johansson.note: Johansson's edge is sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders.
Viktor Johansson.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是提前站位后的快速反应。他会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。他也会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Yasin Ayari.note: Ayari's edge is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Yasin Ayari.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在防线重组前制造干净射门。他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。
